attempts.answer: 使用的密钥为 K5 解密明文为 AHTLFEBAHF
attempts.certificate: 按高位到低位的零基槽位索引，记 Q=P^{-1}。首字节为 B0，右旋一位后为 58；Q(B0)=45，Q(58)=C8，且 Q(K1…K5)=(6C,E2,0C,AB,89)。首字符候选（按 K1…K5 排列）为：方案1、步长0：(29,A7,49,EE,CC)；方案1、步长1：(A4,2A,C4,63,41)；方案2、步长0：(91,58,85,28,2D)；方案2、步长1：(1C,D5,08,A5,A0)。仅方案1、步长1、K5 的首字符是大写字母。对十个字节解密得到 41 48 54 4C 46 45 42 41 48 46，即 AHTLFEBAHF。校验：ASCII 和为 709，模9为7；首尾不同；有7种不同字符，最高出现次数为2；第8位A、第5位F；元音为A、A、E，共3个。

judges.reason: Using the stated permutation convention, for plaintext byte A=0x41 the set input bits are 6 and 0. Since P[7]=6 and P[4]=0, permutation P produces 0x90. Scheme 1 with K5 then gives ROL1(0x90 XOR 0x68)=ROL1(0xF8)=0xF1, not the first ciphertext byte 0xB0. Thus the supplied plaintext/key pair does not satisfy the stated encryption pipeline; the certificate's claimed Q(58)=C8 is also inconsistent with the stated P.
